dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, jagged outer perimeters of light-toned annular structures with sharp gradient transitions from the dark dorsal ground to the light interior, most prominent in the mid-dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of solid light-toned pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, concentrated primarily in the anterior-dorsal region and transitioning to isolated blobs near the posterior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest macro-annuli in the mid-back form an obtuse scalene triangle; a pair of high-intensity blobs near the base of the hind flipper defines a longitudinal vector.
